name: joshgpt
description: Minimal JoshGPT VS Code extension template with LM Studio support, local shell tooling, and optional MCP integrations.

joshgpt.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the LM Studio OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

joshgpt.chatEndpointMode.description: Chat transport mode. 'openai-compat' supports MCP tool-calling; 'lmstudio-native-stream' streams native LM Studio events (including reasoning.* when supported).

joshgpt.nativeBaseUrl.description: Base URL for LM Studio native REST endpoint (used with joshgpt.chatEndpointMode=lmstudio-native-stream).

joshgpt.model.description: Model ID served by LM Studio for JoshGPT requests.

joshgpt.apiKey.description: Bearer token sent to LM Studio endpoint.

joshgpt.systemPrompt.default: You are JoshGPT, a concise coding assistant.
joshgpt.systemPrompt.description: Optional system prompt prepended to each JoshGPT request.

joshgpt.mcp.enabled.description: Enable MCP tool calling during JoshGPT completions.

joshgpt.mcp.maxToolRounds.description: Maximum assistant tool-call rounds per prompt.

joshgpt.supervisor.enabled.description: Enable extension-side Codex supervisor wrapper tool in openai-compat mode.

joshgpt.supervisor.modelEscalationEnable.description: Allow the model to initiate supervisor escalation via request_codex_supervisor_decision.

joshgpt.supervisor.dispatcherBaseUrl.description: Dispatcher MCP endpoint used by supervisor wrapper orchestration.

joshgpt.supervisor.maxEscalationsPerTurn.description: Guardrail: maximum supervisor escalations allowed per prompt turn.

joshgpt.supervisor.maxEscalationsPerSess.description: Guardrail: maximum supervisor escalations allowed per session.

joshgpt.supervisor.escalationCooldownMs.description: Guardrail: minimum cooldown interval between supervisor escalations.

joshgpt.supervisor.logLevel.description: Supervisor telemetry verbosity in Output > JoshGPT. 'off' disables supervisor telemetry logs.

joshgpt.supervisor.workerRoleSlug.description: Fallback worker role slug used when .joshgpt/supervision.json is missing.

joshgpt.supervisor.supervisorRoleSlug.description: Fallback supervisor role slug used when .joshgpt/supervision.json is missing.

joshgpt.supervisor.assignedRoleSlug.description: Optional explicit supervisor assignment (registry slug). When valid, this overrides supervision-profile supervisor role selection.

joshgpt.supervisor.roleCatalogCacheTtlMs.description: Role catalog cache TTL in milliseconds before re-fetching list_role_catalog from dispatcher.

joshgpt.telemetry.enabled.description: Enable structured NDJSON telemetry logging for turn correlation.

joshgpt.telemetry.logDir.description: Directory for telemetry NDJSON logs. Relative paths resolve from workspace root.

joshgpt.telemetry.includeContent.description: Include prompt/response/tool payload content in telemetry events.

joshgpt.telemetry.maxFileSizeMb.description: Telemetry file rotation size in megabytes.

joshgpt.telemetry.maxFiles.description: Maximum rotated telemetry files to retain.

joshgpt.instructions.inheritVscodeInstru.description: Inject inherited workspace instructions (canonical AGENTS first) into every model request.

joshgpt.instructions.maxChars.description: Maximum characters allowed for inherited instruction context per request.

joshgpt.localShell.enabled.description: Enable extension-host local shell tool calling (run_local_shell_command).

joshgpt.localShell.defaultTimeoutSeconds.description: Default timeout for local shell tool calls.

joshgpt.localShell.maxTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum allowed timeout for local shell tool calls.

joshgpt.localShell.defaultMaxOutputChars.description: Default output truncation cap per stream for local shell tool calls.

joshgpt.localShell.maxOutputChars.description: Maximum output truncation cap per stream for local shell tool calls.

joshgpt.localShell.mirrorTerminalEnabled.description: Mirror local shell tool execution to a dedicated VS Code terminal in real time.

joshgpt.localShell.mirrorTerminalName.description: Name of the terminal used for local shell mirror mode.

joshgpt.localShell.mirrorTerminalReveal.description: Reveal the mirrored local shell terminal whenever a local shell tool call starts.
